quest.title: Qingce's Lanterns
quest.description: Something seems to be bothering Granny Ruoxin from Qingce Village...

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: *sigh* The Lantern Rite is here once again...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there something on your mind, Granny Ruoxin?

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: Things should be festive and lively during the Lantern Rite, you know?

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: But in Qingce Village, the elderly are too old and the young are too young.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: All those young workers that have since flocked to the big city are either too busy and can't get time off work to celebrate the festival...

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: Or they're too far away to make it back home in time.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: Lantern Rite is a lively festival, it's a time when everyone should gather together to celebrate...

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: Sure, I understand that it mustn't be easy for them either, but... *sigh* What about all the festivities?

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: Ugh, there's no use in complaining. That's no way to celebrate...

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: If you'd be so kind, I'm sure Ms. Bai could use a hand right about now.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: The young lady said that she wanted to prepare a table full of food for everyone and is already hard at work on the preparations. I'm afraid that she won't be able to manage on her own...

response.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
response.text: Oh, thank you. You're too kind!

choices.text: Don't worry, I'll go lend her a hand.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: Seems we still need quite a few more ingredients...

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: Let me lend you a hand.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: Huh? Oh, are you willing to help? You've come right on time! I was just starting to worry that we wouldn't manage to get all the ingredients.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: Let me see here... If you could, please help me get three chunks of Raw Meat and three pieces of Fowl.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: In the meantime, I'll think of a way to procure the other ingredients.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: Great, that should be just enough. Ah yes, I'll also need you to help me go to Pops Kai and tell him to bring all the chairs and tables over.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: I plan on making lots of dishes, so if we wait too long to set up the tables, I'm afraid that the food might start getting cold.

talks.objective: Help Ms. Bai prepare three servings of Raw Meat and Fowl each

dialogues.speaker: Pops Kai
dialogues.text: Oh? Are you looking for me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We'll be needing the tables and chairs soon.

dialogues.speaker: Pops Kai
dialogues.text: Ah yes, the tables and chairs... I remember now. I've already prepared everything.

dialogues.speaker: Pops Kai
dialogues.text: Ah, but there should still be some more inside the shop. Alrighty, let's just bring them all out then.

dialogues.speaker: Pops Kai
dialogues.text: That should be enough tables and chairs for everybody.

dialogues.speaker: Pops Kai
dialogues.text: I never expected that you'd come all the way here to help me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm happy that I could help.

dialogues.speaker: Pops Kai
dialogues.text: #Heh! I must say that you're quite an extraordinary young {M#man}{F#lady}... But why haven't you gone home yet? Don't you plan on celebrating with your family?

response.speaker: Pops Kai
response.text: No need to fret, I won't ask any further. I'm sure you have your reasons.

response.speaker: Pops Kai
response.text: If you're willing to celebrate the festival here, you're more than welcome to join us. As they say, the more the merrier.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: *sigh* Who knows when the young folks will finally get some time to rest...

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: With so many of us gathered together now, things are finally starting to feel like a festival.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: Heh, now let's release this Xiao Lantern together, shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: I wish everyone excellent health and good fortune in the coming year.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: And may all the youngsters, wherever they are, see their dreams come true...

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: Alright Granny Ruoxin, if we wait any longer, the food I prepared will start getting cold.

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: Wow! Look at all the tasty food!

dialogues.speaker: Dongdong
dialogues.text: Can we go now, Granny?

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: Oh, children... Very well then, off you go now.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Won't you be joining them, Granny Ruoxin?

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: Oh, me? I'm in no hurry. Besides, I'd like to watch the Xiao Lanterns awhile longer.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: Which reminds me, these are for you, dear. It's my way of saying thank you for helping prepare all the festivities.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thank you, Granny Ruoxin.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: You're most welcome. From the looks of it, you must still be quite young. I imagine that all this running around must have left you quite tuckered out indeed...

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: Why don't you stay with us for a while and join the festivities?

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: It's good to have a rest after rushing about all year long...

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: Ah, you're back. Sorry for making you do so much work on a festive day like this.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm glad I could help.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: Thank you, you're too kind. I've also been doing my part and managed to make quite a few Xiao Lanterns for the people of Qingce Village.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: If you'd like, you can find me near the gate later this evening. We'll release the Xiao Lanterns and celebrate the festival together.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: But who knows where the children have run off to... There's no way I could go and find them with these old legs...

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: Could I trouble you to round them up for me? They've always loved releasing the Xiao Lanterns.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: And be sure to tell anyone else you find along the way to head back to the village... The more the merrier, you know.

dialogues.speaker: Little You
dialogues.text: Ugh, I still can't catch my shadow.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We'll be releasing Xiao Lanterns in the village soon...

dialogues.speaker: Little You
dialogues.text: We get to release the Xiao Lanterns tonight? Awesome! Lemme go tell my big brother!

dialogues.speaker: Little You
dialogues.text: I heard grandpa say that we get to make a wish when we release the lanterns. Is that true?

dialogues.speaker: Little You
dialogues.text: I have a big wish that I've been thinking about for a long time now...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Oh really? What's your wish?

dialogues.speaker: Little You
dialogues.text: It's that I... Ah wait, I shouldn't tell you... Grandpa says that if we tell others our wishes, they'll never come true.

dialogues.speaker: Little You
dialogues.text: Just wait till I tell my big brother, I'm sure he'll have a wish too!

dialogues.speaker: Little You
dialogues.text: Oh wait, it seems we have to write our wish on a lantern... So I guess just thinking about it won't be enough.

dialogues.speaker: Little Luo
dialogues.text: I wonder if Mr. Adeptus will come to Lantern Rite...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We'll be releasing Xiao Lanterns in the village soon...

dialogues.speaker: Little Luo
dialogues.text: Oh, we'll be releasing the lanterns back at the village? Thanks for letting me know.

dialogues.speaker: Little Luo
dialogues.text: If we release enough Xiao Lanterns, maybe Mr. Adeptus will come...

dialogues.speaker: Chang the Ninth
dialogues.text: Ah, hello. Do you need anything?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We'll be releasing Xiao Lanterns in the village soon...

dialogues.speaker: Chang the Ninth
dialogues.text: Granny Ruoxin will be releasing the lanterns? *sigh* She'll probably start to worry if I don't show up...

dialogues.speaker: Chang the Ninth
dialogues.text: Alright, thanks for letting me know. I'll make my way over there shortly. At a festival like this one... the more, the merrier.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangcheng
dialogues.text: Wife... Wife?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We'll be releasing Xiao Lanterns in the village soon...

dialogues.speaker: Jiangcheng
dialogues.text: Xiao Lanterns? Ah yes, I remember now. Hmm, I suppose it is about time to release the lanterns.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangcheng
dialogues.text: Thankfully Granny Ruoxin always remembers such traditions. Let's go make a wish together, shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sure.

talks.objective: Head to the entrance of Qingce Village at night (18:00 – 00:00)

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: Were you able to get those three chunks of Raw Meat and Fowl?

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: You're here. Well then, let us prepare. We shall begin releasing the Xiao Lanterns once night falls.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Please wait a moment...

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: Ah, you must still have others you'd like to invite then? We can wait awhile longer.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: I think we've got just about everything we need...

dialogues.speaker: Pops Kai
dialogues.text: This year's festival is turning out to be quite the big one...

dialogues.speaker: Little Luo
dialogues.text: I wonder if Mr. Adeptus will come to Lantern Rite...

dialogues.speaker: Chang the Ninth
dialogues.text: At a festival like this one... the more, the merrier.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangcheng
dialogues.text: Think it's about time to release a Xiao Lantern now...

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: It's such a busy Lantern Rite this year...

dialogues.speaker: Pops Kai
dialogues.text: This is exactly how a festival should be!

dialogues.speaker: Yundan
dialogues.text: Heh, thank you. Let's go release some Xiao Lanterns in a bit.

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: When will I get to release a Xiao Lantern...

dialogues.speaker: Dongdong
dialogues.text: I wonder what food I should try...
